title: The algebraic closure of a field in an algebraically closed field is an algebraic closure
statement: Let $F$ be a field and let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field together with a field homomorphism $F\to\Omega$ [def-pc-field-extension], [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $\overline F=\{\alpha\in\Omega:\alpha\text{ algebraic over }F\}$ be the algebraic closure of $F$ in $\Omega$ [def-weil-relative-algebraic-closure], a subfield of $\Omega$ containing the image of $F$. Then $\overline F$ is algebraically closed, hence (being algebraic over $F$) an algebraic closure of $F$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure]; it is contained in $\Omega$, so $F\subseteq\overline F\subseteq\Omega$.
